posts.title: Here and in Tulum
posts.description: We are doing amazingly well, all things considered. Joe had another trip to see the orthopaedic surgeon. She was pleased, as his bone hasn't shifted. He is good for 10 days until we go back and see her. This next appointment will tell us if anything has shifted, and if he needs surgery and a plate. posts.title: Saturday's Critters
posts.description: I'd put a camera at The Point, to see who was trodding paths in the wetland. I have such gratitude that I can walk out here. Turns out, the otter, red squirrel and doe were there. posts.title: Crumbly Acres
posts.description: I got a lot done yesterday. I've been having a hard time focusing, but I'm getting there.We released a squirrel. We released #75 two years ago, then 76, 77, 78 last year. Two of them are hanging around. I'm calling him #79! That was not his 'number,' but that's what we're going with.
